feasible.description: false only as a last resort: the bug cannot occur on an iOS simulator, needs a Debug bundle or Metro, needs custom native code with no reachable public-API path, or the issue has no usable reproduction and is too vague to design one.

reason.description: One or two sentences. When feasible is false, why. When feasible is true, how the plan was derived.

summary.description: One paragraph that describes the bug in your own words.

library.description: The package whose behaviour is wrong.

platform.description: Only ios is supported by the reproduction runner.

reactNativeVersion.description: Exact react-native version that exists on npm, for example 0.81.4.

reanimatedVersion.description: Exact react-native-reanimated version that exists on npm.

workletsVersion.description: Exact react-native-worklets version that exists on npm, or null for Reanimated 3.x.

appKind.description: rn-cli scaffolds with @react-native-community/cli. expo scaffolds with create-expo-app and runs expo prebuild.

expoSdkVersion.description: Expo SDK major, for example 54, when appKind is expo. null otherwise.

reproductionSource.description: Where the code in argent-cloud-work/repro/ came from. Informational only. The build never installs or executes the linked reproduction.

copiedFrom.description: Paths inside the linked reproduction that you copied or adapted, relative to its root.

extraDependencies.description: npm packages, besides react-native, react-native-reanimated and react-native-worklets, that the app needs. Only names from allowed-dependencies.json are accepted, each with an exact version that exists on npm.

reproductionSteps.description: Ordered steps that a tester performs in the built app on a simulator. Each step names what to tap or do and what to look at.

verification.description: How the tester decides whether the bug reproduced.

how.description: What to observe or measure and with which tool, for example the on-screen text, ps -o rss on the app process, or xcrun simctl spawn <udid> log stream.

passSignal.description: What the tester sees or measures when the bug does NOT reproduce.

failSignal.description: What the tester sees or measures when the bug reproduces.
